scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Role, Property, State, and Tabindex Attributes > treegrid / aria-label
scenarios.notes: The container has role treegrid and an accessible name.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Role, Property, State, and Tabindex Attributes > row
scenarios.notes: Every row container has role row, including child rows.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Role, Property, State, and Tabindex Attributes > gridcell
scenarios.notes: Cells that are not column or row headers have role gridcell.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties > aria-expanded
scenarios.notes: A parent row reports aria-expanded=true when its child rows are displayed.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties > aria-expanded
scenarios.notes: Rows that do not control child rows must not have aria-expanded.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties > aria-level / aria-setsize / aria-posinset
scenarios.notes: Setsize/posinset count siblings within the same branch and level, one-based.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > roving tabindex
scenarios.notes: One row or cell carries tabindex=0; all others are -1 (roving tabindex).

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Right Arrow
scenarios.notes: Right Arrow on a focused collapsed row expands it and does not move focus.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Right Arrow
scenarios.notes: Right Arrow on a focused expanded row moves focus to the first cell.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Right Arrow
scenarios.notes: On a cell that is not right-most, Right Arrow moves one cell right.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Right Arrow
scenarios.notes: Focus does not move from the right-most cell.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Left Arrow
scenarios.notes: Left Arrow on a focused expanded row collapses it, hiding child rows.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Left Arrow
scenarios.notes: Left Arrow on a collapsed (leaf) row moves focus to its parent row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Left Arrow
scenarios.notes: When row focus is supported, Left Arrow on the first cell focuses the row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Left Arrow
scenarios.notes: On a non-first cell, Left Arrow moves one cell left.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Down Arrow
scenarios.notes: With a row focused, Down Arrow moves one visible row down.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Up Arrow
scenarios.notes: With a row focused, Up Arrow moves one visible row up.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Down Arrow
scenarios.notes: With a cell focused, Down Arrow moves one cell down in the same column.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Up Arrow
scenarios.notes: With a cell focused, Up Arrow moves one cell up in the same column.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Tab
scenarios.notes: Tab moves to the first interactive widget in the current row; widget targets use <cell>/<widget>.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Shift + Tab
scenarios.notes: Shift+Tab with a row focused moves focus out of the treegrid.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Shift + Tab
scenarios.notes: With a cell widget focused, Shift+Tab moves to the previous interactive widget in the row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Home
scenarios.notes: With a row focused, Home moves to the first row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Home
scenarios.notes: With a cell focused, Home moves to the first cell in that row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > End
scenarios.notes: With a row focused, End moves to the last visible row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > End
scenarios.notes: With a cell focused, End moves to the last cell in that row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Control + Home
scenarios.notes: With a cell focused, Control+Home moves to the first row in the same column.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Control + End
scenarios.notes: With a cell focused, Control+End moves to the last row in the same column.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Enter
scenarios.notes: In cells-only focus, Enter on the first cell with aria-expanded toggles child rows.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Keyboard Support > Enter
scenarios.notes: Enter on a row performs its default action.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties > multi-select aria-selected
scenarios.notes: Multi-select treegrid marks all rows aria-selected; selected rows true.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties > single-select aria-selected
scenarios.notes: In single-select, aria-selected is present only on the selected row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > About This Pattern > focus vs selection
scenarios.notes: Moving focus does not change the selected row in a multi-select treegrid.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Treegrid Pattern > Keyboard Interaction > Shift + Space
scenarios.notes: Shift+Space selects the row that contains focus.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Example Usage Options > Rows are focused first
scenarios.notes: Rows-first navigation puts initial focus on the first row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Example Usage Options > Cells are focused first
scenarios.notes: Cells-first navigation puts initial focus on the first cell but rows remain focusable.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Example Usage Options > Only cells can be focused
scenarios.notes: In cells-only mode, Left Arrow on the first cell does not move focus to the row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > Role, Property, State, and Tabindex Attributes > aria-expanded
scenarios.notes: In cells-only mode aria-expanded lives on the first cell, not the row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Email Inbox treegrid example > roving tabindex > single tabindex=0
scenarios.notes: Roving tabindex moves the single tabindex=0 to the focused row.
